newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Mobilcom sees higher 1997 pre-tax profit.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Mobilcom sees higher 1997 pre-tax profit.

text.p: Mobile phone group Mobilcom AG, which plans to list shares on Germany's new growth index Neue Markt this month, said on Monday it expects pre-tax earnings to rise more than 40 percent this year.
Mobilcom board member Carsten Meyer told reporters in Frankfurt that pre-earnings were expected to rise to 17.1 million marks this year after 12.1 million marks in 1996.
Sales would rise less sharply to 314 million marks from 309 million marks and the company expected the number of subscribers to rise 50,000 to 210,000 by the end of the year.
The workforce would grow slightly to 257 employees from 222 at the end of 1996.

Mobilcom AG is offering shares to investors during the bookbuilding phase of its listing in range of 52.50 to 62.50 marks. It is offering 640,000 common shares for sale to the public in a bookbuilding phase running March 4-6.
The company is taking part in the bourse's new growth stock market, or Neue Markt, which gets off the ground on March 10.
